title: Room-Traffic Shares for Carpet Replacement Charges on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Rule.** The room a carpet lay in sets a room-traffic share for its carpet replacement charge on a Security Deposit Account:

- **0.88** for a carpet in the living room, the dining area or the entry;
- **0.92** for a carpet in the den;
- **1**, the charge in full, for a carpet in any other room.

The corrected carpet charge is multiplied by the room-traffic share, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Records read.** The room recorded on the carpet replacement line of the account.

| Room recorded on the carpet line | Room-traffic share |
|---|---|
| living room | 0.88 |
| dining area | 0.88 |
| entry | 0.88 |
| den | 0.92 |
| a bedroom, a hallway or any other room | 1 |

**Hypothetical figures.** A carpet charge worked out at 500.00 USD before this share becomes 440.00 USD in the living room and 460.00 USD in the den. In a bedroom it stays at 500.00 USD.
